mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies and a comfortable temperature of 80 degrees, providing perfect weather to visit Harriet Park.

The Verona Common Council has unanimously adopted the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan. This document, developed with significant public input, serves as a long-range vision for our city, focusing on housing, infrastructure, and sustainable growth over the coming decades.
There is plenty to do in our community. Yoga at Insight Wellness is held today, followed by several trivia nights tomorrow including events at Hop Haus and Wisconsin Brewing Company.
In our weekly police report, on September 28, officers responded to a motor vehicle crash involving injuries where a juvenile was cited for reckless driving and operating without a license.
Stop by Culver's today for the delicious Georgia Peach flavor. The restaurant is currently open and will remain ready to serve you until 10:00 PM tonight.
